In [14]:
norm_dict = {
    "yg": "yang", "dpt": "dapat", "mbg": "makan bergizi gratis",
    "ga": "tidak", "gak": "tidak", "tdk": "tidak", "klo": "kalau",
    "bgt": "banget", "sm": "sama", "utk": "untuk", "dr": "dari",
    "gw": "saya", "gmn": "bagaimana", "udh": "sudah", "udah": "sudah",
    "prabs": "prabowo", "gemoy": "lucu"
}

factory = StopWordRemoverFactory()
indo_stopwords = set(factory.get_stop_words() + stopwords.words('indonesian'))
indo_stopwords.discard('tidak')

def text_cleansing(text):
    if pd.isna(text): return ""
    
    text = str(text).lower()
    
    text = re.sub(r'http\S+|www\S+|https\S+', '', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    text = re.sub(r'\@\w+|\#\w+', '', text)
    
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z\s]', ' ', text)
    
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
    
    words = text.split()
    normalized_words = [norm_dict.get(word, word) for word in words]
    
    final_words = [word for word in normalized_words if word not in indo_stopwords]
    
    return " ".join(final_words)

df_train['clean_text'] = df_train['full_text'].apply(text_cleansing)
print(df_train[['full_text', 'clean_text']].head())

for i, category in enumerate(unique_labels):

    if len(text_corpus.strip()) > 0:
        wordcloud = WordCloud(width=600, height=300, 
                              background_color='white', 
                              colormap='viridis',
                              max_words=50).generate(text_corpus)
        
        axes[i].imshow(wordcloud, interpolation='bilinear')
    else:
        axes[i].text(0.5, 0.5, 'Tidak ada teks tersisa', 
                     horizontalalignment='center', verticalalignment='center')
        
    axes[i].set_title(f'Kelas: {category}', fontweight='bold', fontsize=14)
    axes[i].axis('off')

import pandas as pd
import requests
from nltk.tokenize import word_tokenize
from collections import Counter
from IPython.display import display

print("--- SISTEM PENDETEKSI KATA TIDAK BAKU (OOV) ---")

url_kbbi = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sutabs/kbbi/master/kbbi.txt"
try:
    response = requests.get(url_kbbi)
    kbbi_words = set(response.text.split('\n'))
    print(f"   [SUKSES] {len(kbbi_words)} kata baku berhasil dimuat!")
except Exception as e:
    print("   [GAGAL] Tidak dapat mengunduh KBBI. Pastikan koneksi internet aktif.")
    kbbi_words = set()

all_text = " ".join(df_train['clean_text'].astype(str).tolist())
all_words = word_tokenize(all_text)
word_freq = Counter(all_words)

try:
    dict_to_check = dynamic_norm_dict
except NameError:
    try:
        dict_to_check = norm_dict
    except NameError:
        dict_to_check = {} 

oov_words = {
    word: freq for word, freq in word_freq.items() 
    if word not in kbbi_words           
    and word not in dict_to_check    
    and word.isalpha()               
}


top_50_oov = sorted(oov_words.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:50]
df_top_oov = pd.DataFrame(top_50_oov, columns=['Kata Asing / Slang', 'Frekuensi Muncul'])
df_top_oov.index = df_top_oov.index + 1

print("\n=== TABEL TOP 50 KATA UNTUK DINORMALISASI ===")
display(df_top_oov)

from transformers import Trainer
import numpy as np
import evaluate

metric = evaluate.load("accuracy")

from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
def compute_metrics(eval_pred):
    logits, labels = eval_pred
    predictions = np.argmax(logits, axis=-1)
    return {"macro_f1": f1_score(labels, predictions, average="macro")}

trainer = Trainer(
    model=model,
    args=training_args,
    train_dataset=train_dataset,
    eval_dataset=eval_dataset,
    compute_metrics=compute_metrics,
)
